en.headline: Construction-site smoking ban: 44 fixed penalties in first three weeks
en.dek: The Labour Department also issued 12 improvement notices to contractors and is considering prosecutions in two cases after the ban took effect on 17 July.
body: One month after the territory-wide ban on smoking at construction sites took effect, the Labour Department said it had issued 44 fixed-penalty notices of HK$3,000 in the first three weeks up to 8 August.

Of those, 26 related to new building works and 18 to renovation or maintenance sites. The department also issued 12 improvement notices to contractors for failing to take all reasonable steps to prevent smoking on site, and is considering prosecuting two renovation contractors.

In the same period the department inspected 1,721 sites and received 111 complaints about smoking. The Construction Site Workers General Union said the situation had improved markedly, with some workers choosing to quit or cut back, though concerns remained about blacklisting by contractors.

zh.headline: 地盤全面禁煙滿月 首三周發44張定額罰款通知書
zh.dek: 勞工處截至8月8日巡查1,721個地盤，另向承建商發12張敦促改善通知書，擬檢控兩宗個案。
body: 建築地盤全面禁煙法例於7月17日生效滿一個月。勞工處表示，截至本月8日，共發出44張定額罰款通知書（每張3,000元），其中26張涉及新建築工程地盤，18張涉及裝修及維修地盤。
處方亦就承建商未有採取所有合理步驟確保地盤內無人吸煙，發出12張敦促改善通知書，並擬就兩宗違規個案向涉事裝修及維修地盤承建商提出檢控。同期共巡查1,721個地盤，接獲111宗有關地盤吸煙的投訴。
建造業總工會表示，地盤吸煙情況已大為改善，部分工人選擇戒煙或減少吸煙，但擔心承建商設立黑名單。
